'''Jeff Field Tatooine Shuffle''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Jeff Field]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/shuffle.html Jeff Field's Tatooine Shuffle], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991023002833/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/shuffle.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jeff Field]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut|Premiere-L-tatooineobiwanshut.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine Shuffle
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Field LS Tatooine Shuffle Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
A Tatooine drain deck by [[Jeff Field]], who Feldman wrote had "reigned as the #1 player" in Northern California at 14. It drains at Tatooine and fights with lightsabers and [[Gift Of The Mentor]].<ref name="torch" />
